units.source_text: “帐房有人嬉笑着告诉我说：‘小驹，到山茶厅去看看吧。’

en.t: At the front desk someone laughed and told me, 'Koma, go take a look in the Camellia Room.'

units.source_text: 刚送阿姐上了火车，本想回来舒舒服服地睡它一觉，可是她们说这儿来过电话。

en.t: I had just seen my sister onto the train and meant to come back and sleep comfortably, but they said a call had come from here.

units.source_text: 我已经很困乏了，真不想来了。

en.t: I was already exhausted and really did not want to come.

units.source_text: 昨晚为阿姐饯行，喝多了。

en.t: Last night I drank too much at my sister's farewell party.

units.source_text: 在帐房那儿她们一个劲地取笑我。

en.t: At the front desk they kept teasing me.
So it was you who had come.

units.source_text: 又过一年了，这人是一年才来一次吗？”

en.t: Another year has gone by. Is this someone who only comes once a year?
I ate those bean paste buns too.
